_comment: DA-1795 frontend (CX) configs for an MDS solar pilot. Section A = verified present and delivered to the browser on 73969 (24 Aug 2026). Section B = read by the deployed bundle but NEVER SET on 73969 - these are the ones to add. Section B values are RECOMMENDED, not yet verified in a live UI (the config write was blocked in the analysis session).

_sectionA_verified_present.configDocumentation: Master web-dashboard enable. Without it the dashboard crashes.
Energy Details version. Already V3 - the remaining D+R chart bugs are NOT caused by this.
Monthly Summary version. V3 is what renders the working Energy Received / Energy Delivered split.
Enables the full bill breakdown block.
Solar variant of the above. Required for solar users.
MANDATORY for solar users. The bundle does JSON.parse on this key; if it is missing the Insights page white-screens on #root.
MANDATORY for solar + non-disagg users (which is 73969's state). Same JSON.parse white-screen risk.
Which Energy Details modes a solar user sees. NOTE: MONTH currently renders broken because of the daily-aggregation defect (D1). Consider ["YEAR"] until D1 is fixed.
Landing mode for solar users. YEAR is the only mode that currently works.
Currency symbol. Missing value causes render errors.
Required to avoid a peak-demand render error.

_sectionB_MISSING_add_these.configDocumentation: HIGH PRIORITY. Read by getSolarBillingType() in the deployed bundle. When 'invoice' the Home layout uses BILL_HISTORY; when unset/other it routes to NET_BILL_HISTORY, which has NO entry in dynamic_layout_configs, so the Home Usage History widget silently disappears. This is the confirmed cause of the missing Home Usage History on 73969.
HIGH PRIORITY. Gates the two-stream Energy Received / Energy Delivered card on the Home Bill Summary widget. Unset on 73969 and the Home Bill Summary does not render at all.
Monthly Summary V3 solar stream card. The card renders anyway on 73969, but set it explicitly rather than relying on the default.

Read by the bundle's accessibility helper. Unset on 73969 and contributes to the AC 6.3 ADA failure. NOTE: setting this alone does NOT fix ADA - the Highcharts accessibility.js module is not loaded at all, which is a Web-team code fix.

LOW PRIORITY / currently benign. Chooses ALLOWED_VIEWS vs NON_DISAGG.ALLOWED_VIEWS. Unset falls through to the NON_DISAGG keys, which are set, so behaviour is correct today. Set it only when disagg is turned on. Value shape is a segment/type/fuel mapping - confirm with Web before setting.
